ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Electron Application Child Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of electron apps (teams, discord, slack, etc.). This could be a potential sign of ".asar" file tampering (See reference section for more information) or binary execution proxy through specific CLI arguments (see related rule)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\discord\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\GitHubDesktop\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\keybase\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msteams\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\slack\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\teams\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Discord\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\NVSMI\\\\nvidia\\-smi\\\.exe.*")))
